annotations.title: Loading dock height and leveler check

description: The grade a dock leveler works at between the lowest and highest truck bed you serve, against the 10% (electric) and 15% (gas or diesel) limits, the shortest standard leveler length that fits, and whether two makers published working ranges cover it.

bed_high_in.description: Highest truck bed height you serve, in inches.

bed_low_in.description: Lowest truck bed height you serve, in inches (20 to 80). Vehicle beds range from 30 to 62 in.

dock_height_in.description: Dock floor height above the driveway in inches (20 to 80). The most common dock height is 48 to 52 in.

equipment.description: electric = pallet, skid or electric fork trucks (10% grade limit); combustion = gas or diesel fork trucks (15%).

leveler_ft.description: Leveler length in feet. Standard lengths are 6, 8, 10 and 12 ft.

name: loading_dock_height_and_leveler_check
